purpose: Source discovery and navigation; not an installed protocol answer database.
scope: All 94 entries in the observed AARC clinical-practice-guideline index, all five visible AARC guidance documents, and seven selected NBRC references. Not every publication on either website.

records.title: AARC and PALISI Clinical Practice Guideline: Pediatric Critical Asthma (2025)
records.display_title: Pediatric Critical Asthma (2025)
records.year_basis: year printed in catalog title; not inferred from URL upload date

rights.basis: Copyright holder and a personal-use restriction are printed in the linked PDF; no shared-app reuse licence was established.

records.description: A joint AARC/PALISI guideline for children with critical asthma. It evaluates medication strategies, respiratory support and use of a care pathway. Recommendations vary in certainty, and several questions have no recommendation for or against an intervention. This description is a navigation aid; the complete recommendation and its qualifiers remain in the original.

records.display_title: Patient-Ventilator Assessment (2024)
records.year_basis: year printed in catalog title; not inferred from URL upload date

rights.basis: The first page identifies a 2024 Daedalus copyright. No app-redistribution licence established.

records.description: A guideline on assessing the person receiving mechanical ventilation together with their airway, interface, humidification and ventilator data. Its recommendations have different evidence grades. It distinguishes direct bedside assessment from supplemental remote monitoring. This is a topic description, not a substitute for the recommendation details or a complete bedside checklist.

records.display_title: Spontaneous Breathing Trials for Liberation From Adult Mechanical Ventilation (2024)
records.year_basis: year printed in catalog title; not inferred from URL upload date

rights.basis: The linked advance-publication PDF identifies a 2024 Daedalus copyright. No app-redistribution licence established.

records.description: An adult ventilator-liberation guideline addressing readiness assessment, breathing-trial technique, timing and oxygen settings. Its recommendations are conditional and carry different evidence-certainty levels. Passing a breathing trial and being ready for extubation are separate judgments. The file linked from the AARC catalog is an advance-publication version, so compare it with the final published article before adopting answer mappings.
records.version_note: Linked file is marked paper in press, published March 5, 2024; its notice says the final version may differ.

records.description: A guideline covering suction through artificial airways in neonatal, pediatric and adult populations. This source description intentionally supplies no detached settings or procedure instructions.
